_comment: Where this brain's MCP table lives, read by core/scripts/mcp-table-check.py at session start.
Copy to .claude/rules/mcp-table.json ONLY if the table is not in the core template's place
(.claude/rules/intelligence-instance.md, section '## MCP Servers'). table = repo-relative file,
heading = the heading line the table sits under (its start is enough). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
builtin_servers = servers the harness brings itself (no .mcp.json, no plugin names them) that the table
documents on purpose, e.g. claude-in-chrome; optional, also a reason to copy this file.
heading: ## MCP Servers
